app.name: linkedcamp
app.label: Linkedcamp
app.description: Linkedcamp is agentic LinkedIn and email outreach for lead generation agencies.

modules.name: watchNewReplies
modules.label: Watch new replies
modules.description: Triggers when a prospect replies in a Linkedcamp campaign.

modules.name: watchConnectionsAccepted
modules.label: Watch new connections accepted
modules.description: Triggers when a prospect accepts a connection request sent by a Linkedcamp campaign.

modules.name: watchConnectionRequestsSent
modules.label: Watch new connection requests sent
modules.description: Triggers when a campaign sends a connection request.

modules.name: watchEmailsSent
modules.label: Watch new emails sent
modules.description: Triggers when a campaign email is sent.

modules.name: watchEmailOpens
modules.label: Watch new email opens
modules.description: Triggers when a campaign email is opened.

modules.name: watchEmailLinkClicks
modules.label: Watch new email link clicks
modules.description: Triggers when a campaign email has a link clicked.

modules.name: watchEmailBounces
modules.label: Watch new email bounces
modules.description: Triggers when a campaign email bounces.

modules.name: watchUnsubscribes
modules.label: Watch new unsubscribes
modules.description: Triggers when a prospect unsubscribes from campaign emails.

modules.name: watchAppointments
modules.label: Watch new appointments
modules.description: Triggers when a meeting is booked from a Linkedcamp conversation.

modules.name: watchCampaigns
modules.label: Watch new campaigns
modules.description: Triggers when a new campaign is created.

modules.name: watchRepliedLeads
modules.label: Watch new replied leads
modules.description: Triggers when a lead reaches the Replied status. Checks leads that replied in the last 24 hours; each lead triggers once.

modules.name: addLeadToCampaign
modules.label: Add a lead to a campaign
modules.description: Adds a prospect to a Linkedcamp campaign by LinkedIn profile URL or email.

modules.name: addLeadsToCampaign
modules.label: Bulk add leads to a campaign (advanced)
modules.description: Adds up to 5,000 prospect rows to a Linkedcamp campaign in one request. The import runs in the background.

modules.name: updateLead
modules.label: Update a lead
modules.description: Updates a lead's details, personalization or custom fields, or pauses, excludes or marks it interested.

modules.name: addNoteToLead
modules.label: Add a note to a lead
modules.description: Adds an internal note to a lead. Nothing is sent.

modules.name: sendMessage
modules.label: Send a message
modules.description: Sends a message in an existing conversation. It is delivered immediately and cannot be recalled. Warning: this delivers to a real person on LinkedIn or by email as soon as the module runs.

modules.name: draftAiReply
modules.label: Draft an AI reply
modules.description: Drafts a reply with your connected AI provider. Nothing is sent.

modules.name: updateConversation
modules.label: Update a conversation
modules.description: Archives a conversation, marks it read, or hands it between the AI agent and a human.

modules.name: pauseResumeCampaign
modules.label: Pause or resume a campaign
modules.description: Pauses a running campaign or resumes a paused one.

modules.name: launchCampaign
modules.label: Launch a campaign
modules.description: Launches a drafted campaign so it starts sending. Warning: this starts real outreach to real people from the connected LinkedIn account and mailboxes.

modules.name: createDraftCampaign
modules.label: Create a draft campaign
modules.description: Creates a new draft campaign. Nothing is sent until the campaign is launched.

modules.name: addBlacklistEntry
modules.label: Add a blacklist entry
modules.description: Creates a new account-wide blacklist rule that excludes prospects by profile URL, company URL, keyword, job title or email.

modules.name: createTag
modules.label: Create a tag
modules.description: Creates a new tag.

modules.name: createUpdateTask
modules.label: Create or update a task
modules.description: Creates a new task, or updates an existing task by its ID. Nothing is sent to the prospect.

modules.name: createReminder
modules.label: Create a reminder
modules.description: Creates a new follow-up reminder for you on a lead or conversation. Nothing is sent to the prospect.

modules.name: callTool
modules.label: Call a Linkedcamp tool
modules.description: Calls any Linkedcamp MCP tool your API key can use, with JSON arguments. Some tools send messages or start outreach; check the tool before you run it.

modules.name: makeApiCall
modules.label: Make an API call
modules.description: Sends a custom API call to Linkedcamp. You can use this to call endpoints that aren't covered by existing modules.

modules.name: searchCampaigns
modules.label: Search campaigns
modules.description: Returns a list of campaigns filtered by title, status or client sub-account, newest first.

modules.name: getCampaign
modules.label: Get a campaign
modules.description: Returns information about a specific campaign by its ID, including settings, schedule, limits, accounts, lead source, counters and readiness.

modules.name: searchLeads
modules.label: Search leads
modules.description: Returns a list of leads filtered by name, email or company, campaign, status, tags or date range.

modules.name: getLead
modules.label: Get a lead
modules.description: Returns information about a specific lead by its ID, with its activity history and position in the campaign.

modules.name: getCampaignStats
modules.label: Get campaign stats
modules.description: Returns headline performance for a specific campaign by its ID, or for the whole account when no campaign is chosen.

modules.name: getCampaignFunnel
modules.label: Get a campaign funnel
modules.description: Returns stage-by-stage conversion for a specific campaign by its ID. It can be slow on campaigns with many leads.

modules.name: searchConversations
modules.label: Search conversations
modules.description: Returns a list of LinkedIn and email conversations filtered by campaign, keyword, channel, tags or account, newest activity first. It does not mark them as read.

modules.name: searchAppointments
modules.label: Search appointments
modules.description: Returns a list of meetings booked from conversations, filtered by lead, conversation or status.
